core_obligations: Consider the shift of the short exact sequence of the punctured line bundle and note that $\Omega^\bullet_{L^\star/S,0}$ is a differential graded $\mathcal{O}_X$-algebra whose degree zero part receives $\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}$, so that the two maps are maps of right differential graded $\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}$-modules (proof lines 1432-1452).

Deduce from the general theory of differential graded sheaves that $\delta$ comes from a map in $D(\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}, \mathrm{d})$, and use the uniqueness in the remark to reduce the assertion to $\delta(1) = c_1^{dR}(\mathcal{L})$ (proof lines 1453-1460).

Build the commutative diagram of short exact sequences whose top row is a sequence of abelian sheaves with boundary sending $1$ to the class of $\mathcal{L}$, where the middle sheaf $E$ consists of pairs $(s, n)$ with $s$ a local generator of $\mathcal{L}^{\otimes n}$ and group law $(s,n)(t,m) = (s \otimes t, n+m)$, and the vertical maps are $\mathrm{d}\log$ and the residue (proof lines 1462-1492).

Compute the boundary of the class of $\mathcal{L}$ using local trivializations $s_i$ over opens $U_i$ with invertible transition functions $f_{i_0i_1}$: the identity $(f_{i_0i_1}, 0) = (s_{i_1},1)(s_{i_0},1)^{-1}$ in $E$ exhibits the boundary as the Cech cocycle, finishing the proof (proof lines 1493-1505).
proof_roadmap: The graded structure and right dg-module maps (proof lines 1432-1452).
Reduction to the value on $1$ (proof lines 1453-1460).
The comparison diagram with the sheaf of pairs $(s,n)$ (proof lines 1462-1492).
Computation of the boundary via the Cech cocycle (proof lines 1493-1505).
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the boundary map of the punctured line bundle sequence with the map attached to the first de Rham Chern class (statement lines 1421-1429). The proof notes the differential graded module structures that make the boundary a map in the derived category of dg-modules, reduces by the uniqueness in the defining remark to evaluating on the unit, and then computes that value by exhibiting a comparison diagram with the sheaf of pairs consisting of a local generator of a tensor power of the line bundle, using local trivializations to recognise the Cech cocycle of the class. The comparison diagram and the cocycle computation are the substance, so the claim is H2.
